Name: Tailings_Quartermaster_01
Text: Odie. I sell what people leave behind, which since the Collapse is most things. No, I will not tell you who left it. That is the entire business model.
Notes: Vendor greeting. Establishes the town runs on salvage without saying the word.

Name: Tailings_Quartermaster_02
Text: Prices are what they are. I have exactly one competitor and he is a hole in a mountain that keeps everyone who visits.
Notes: Second line. Ties the town to the mine economically - the mine is why Tailings exists.

Name: Tailings_Farmer_01
Text: Sable. I farm. Before you ask: no, I do not know why it grows. The Collapse took every roof on the planet and left my field alone, and I have decided not to interrogate that.
Notes: Farm quest-giver. The unexplained fertility is deliberately left unexplained - it is the same register as the Surveyor's rock.

Name: Tailings_Farmer_02
Text: Four should do it. Take them, eat them, sell them to Odie for a criminal markup - I do not mind. I mind that somebody who is not me has held something that came out of the ground alive.
Notes: Quest hand-off for TailingsHarvest. The last clause is the actual point of the quest.

Name: Tailings_Elder_01
Text: Marguerite. I have lived at the foot of that mountain for sixty-one years and I have counted the lights on it for the last nine weeks. Two on a slow night. Eleven on the worst one.
Notes: Second, independent witness to the drone lights - corroborates the Surveyor from a different town and a different angle. The party hears it twice before they see it once.

Name: Tailings_Elder_02
Text: The surveyor down at the cantina thinks it is claim-jumpers. Bless him. Claim-jumpers do not run in a grid, dear, and they do not stop at the same hour every night as though something told them to.
Notes: Sharper than the Surveyor and closer to the truth without reaching it. Grid patrols and fixed hours = automated survey. She has seen it; she just has no word for a drone.

Name: Tailings_Elder_03
Text: Go and look. That is all I want. Not to be right - I would love to be wrong, at my age being wrong is a holiday. I want somebody to go up there and come back and tell me what colour they are up close.
Notes: Quest hand-off for TailingsLights, which shares the MineShaftHead marker with The Withdrawal. She never gets an answer in this quest; that is intentional.
